title: CPU foundation for gf2-sim pipeline
description:
## Goal

Land the CPU side of the `gf2-sim` pipeline: crate scaffolding,
deterministic-aggregation primitives (per-worker ChaCha20 seek,
order-independent reductions), layered builder + graph APIs, CPU
channel stages, heartbeat-checkpoint integration, and the
determinism property-test harness.

## Context

Story under epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Runs in parallel with
the GPU stages story (lockstep handoff via the Phase 0 design
doc `ec530af9`). Containment for all CPU-side foundation tasks.

## Deliverables (themes)

- New crate `gf2-sim` with `Pipeline` / `Stage<I,O>` / `Connector`
  primitives and batch types.
- Within-SNR frame parallelism + deterministic aggregation (the
  amended issue `3fcb7025` is the core).
- Layered API: typestate builder for the DVB-T2 preset; graph
  API for novel chains.
- CPU AWGN + Rayleigh / Rician channel stages.
- Heartbeat-checkpoint integration with the parallel executor.
- Property-test harness asserting byte-identity across
  {1, 2, 4, 8, 24} workers.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All child tasks complete with required gates green.
- [hard] Determinism property test passes for at least 3
  (rate, modulation) configurations.
- [hard] Receipt artefact under
  `dev/benchmarks/gf2-sim/cpu-foundation-receipts.md` records
  the per-worker speedup and the byte-identity attestation.
- [hard] CLAUDE.md updated with the `gf2-sim` module map and the
  determinism contract.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals; GPU work is in the GPU stages
story.
